Question: Which of the following is the name for a coupon that is included in a package for later purchase?

Options: 
A. an in-store coupon
B. a rebate coupon
C. a discount coupon
D. a mail-in coupon
E. a digital coupon
F. a promotional coupon
G. a bounce-back coupon
H. a peel-off coupon
I. an instant-redemption coupon
J. a free-standing coupon

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
